notes.title: Performance Review - Testers Needed [CLOSED]
notes.content:
I appreciate all of you who have taken an interested in helping me testing out the performance of the maps that will be used in Specters.

I have closed invitations to participate in the beta for a performance test of the maps that will be available to play on in the Early Access release of the game.

To the 16 players that are helping me, I appreciate it.  While access to the maps early is closed to those who are not participating, I do plan to have another beta period roughly 2 weeks prior to the planned early access release of the game.

If you wish to talk about the game, the official discord is located here:

Performance Review - Testers Needed

Thank you,
-Michael

notes.title: Performance Review - Testers Needed
notes.content:
On September 10th, a beta test will occur where I will allow players to test the performance of 3 different maps.  Network testing of the maps will be pending.  This test will not include performance with a ghost or with items.  For the best quality release, I need to know with an array of different systems how the game performs.

I am looking for 10 players to help me and in return, you will be given a free copy of the game upon release once I receive your performance reports.

Please join me on discord where I will select 10 different players to participate in this beta.

https://discord.gg/FnFxaFnvgt

Thank you
-Michael
